createskybound.ponder.launcher.text_1: Fill a square with blocks of quartz. The ship will rest over it.
createskybound.ponder.launcher.text_2: Surround it with a ring of brass casing
createskybound.ponder.launcher.text_3: Each corner takes a Resonance Pylon. The weakest pylon decides how long the run in the Chaotic Skies lasts.
createskybound.ponder.launcher.text_4: Place the Vector Planar Computer on top of the ring. Right-click it to check the platform and charge.
createskybound.ponder.launcher.text_5: Wrench a face of the ring to open that casing into a shaft input, then feed it rotation
createskybound.ponder.launcher.text_6: Rotation charges the launcher. Heavier ships need more charge, and every input on the ring adds to the rate.
createskybound.ponder.launcher.text_7: Bring a ship over the platform
createskybound.ponder.launcher.text_8: When it is fully charged, a redstone signal starts the countdown
createskybound.ponder.launcher.text_9: The ship is thrown up through the clouds and on into the Chaotic Skies. The charge is spent, ready for the next launch.
